description: This file contains functions for language label formatting and translation prompt generation, including templates for Chinese, Japanese, and generic translations, as well as glossary prompt building.

methods.name: prettyLanguageLabel
methods.description: Returns a human-readable language label based on input language code.

methods.name: translationPrompt
methods.description: Generates a translation prompt string based on source and target languages and a glossary.

methods.name: buildGlossaryPrompt
methods.description: Builds a glossary prompt string from a list of glossary entries.
